aboutDescription: I'm Fatma Mohamed Sorour, a .NET Full-Stack Developer with hands-on experience building enterprise web applications using ASP.NET Core, Angular, MSSQL Server, and Web API technologies. I specialize in developing scalable systems, workflow automation platforms, and management dashboards with clean architecture principles and secure backend integrations.

I have practical experience working on real-world enterprise systems including PMO platforms, workflow management systems, shipping systems, and e-commerce solutions. My development approach focuses on performance, maintainability, SOLID principles, and delivering production-ready applications with excellent user experience.
